description: Add starter pet to getDefaultData() so new players begin with 1 Common pet (Buddy) already owned and equipped
steps: Modify getDefaultData() in DataService.lua to include a starter pet in the pets array and equippedPets array
The starter pet should be 'Buddy' (first Common pet from PetData), with id 'starter_pet_1'
acceptance_criteria: getDefaultData() returns pets array with one entry: the Buddy pet with id 'starter_pet_1'
The starter pet has equipped = true
BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx is regenerated and reflects the change
